reordered.from: the seed's membership order (S14, T6, T8)
reordered.item: T8 first, then S14, then T6
reordered.why: T8 is the smallest job (size 5) and its two-independent-refs rule is what the programme's later lessons run on; S14 carries the largest risk reduction because an unrehearsed rollback is the programme's largest single failure mode; T6 is the largest job and depends on T5 and T13, both already delivered.

reestimate.S14: 0 open packages of its own at the 2026-11-28 snapshot; 16 of the 17 declared v4 categories missing (only evidence is published)
reestimate.T6: 0 open packages of its own at the 2026-11-28 snapshot; 13 of the 17 declared v4 categories missing (project-brief, evidence, inception-analysis, architecture-design and closure-review are published)
reestimate.T8: 0 open packages of its own at the 2026-11-28 snapshot; 15 of the 17 declared v4 categories missing (project-brief, evidence and closure-review are published)
